verses: The Lord reigns, he is clothed with majesty; the Lord is robed; he has girded himself with strength: the world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.
The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring.
The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, than the mighty waves of the sea.
Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becomes Thy house, O Lord, for length of days.
